items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yeah, he was working all those tent shows, you know, like Silas Green he was with for a long time.

ctx.x: Yes, I don't know anything come from. So Boyd told me that the last he saw Punch in the 11th East Band up north somewhere.
Oh yeah, he was working all those tent shows, you know, like Silas Green he was with for a long time. They'd go all around.
Punch, punch, punch, punch was it? Chomp it, chomp it, pan, down on Jesus have mercy, drink, liquor.
